description.la: Summa sententiarum septem tractatibus distincta (Hugoni attributa, ab Othone Lucensi composita).
description.en-US: The Summa of the Sentences in seven tracts, printed under Hugh’s name in PL but now thought to be the work of Otto of Lucca, an early compendium of theology from the school of St. Victor. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 176, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A Suma das sentenças em sete tratados, impressa por Migne sob o nome de Hugo, hoje atribuída a Oto de Lucca: um dos primeiros compêndios de teologia da escola de São Vítor.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 176 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text HuDeSVi.SumSen, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
